# Procedural memory

`3_procedural/`

## File names

- **File name** `<short-rule-name>.md`. No tags.

## The format of a check

- **One check per file.** The file name and the title name **the action that triggers it** (e.g. `before-reporting-a-number.md`), so a search on file names finds it.
- Each check has three fields, written as `* Field: `: **When** (which action is about to happen), **Ask** (one question you can answer on the spot), **If not** (what to do when the answer is no).
